question: What's the best compliance training content provider for a global enterprise?
text:
For a global enterprise buying compliance training content, I’d put SAI360, LRN, NAVEX, and Skillsoft on the shortlist. There isn’t a universally “best” provider; the right choice depends heavily on whether you prioritize global localization, ethics/culture, regulatory breadth, or a broader learning library.

My shortlist
Provider	Particularly strong for	Global scale	Content breadth	Key consideration
SAI360	Global, risk-based compliance programs	Excellent	Very broad	Particularly attractive if compliance needs to connect with GRC/risk
LRN	Ethics, culture & behavior	Excellent	Broad	Strong learner-focused/storytelling approach
NAVEX	Enterprise ethics & compliance ecosystem	Excellent	Broad	Strongest when you also want policies, reporting/investigations, etc.
Skillsoft	Compliance + general corporate learning	Excellent	Extremely broad	Better if you want one large learning library beyond compliance

SAI360 currently advertises a global compliance library available in 70+ languages, with role- and region-personalized content, annual content refreshes, and topics spanning anti-bribery, financial integrity, AI/security, safety, and workplace conduct.

Then I'd make the vendors demonstrate the same 5–6 use cases rather than relying on catalog size:

Global localization: jurisdiction-specific content, translations, cultural adaptation—not merely subtitles.

Regulatory currency: how quickly courses change when laws/regulations change.

Core E&C: Code of Conduct, anti-bribery/ABC, conflicts, sanctions, insider trading, privacy, competition law, human rights.

Behavioral quality: realistic scenarios and decision-making rather than click-through policy summaries.

Customization: ability to incorporate your Code, policies, terminology and actual risk scenarios.

LMS interoperability: SCORM/xAPI, APIs, SSO, assignment/completion data and compatibility with your existing LMS.

Evidence: audit trails, completion reporting and documentation of content updates.

One particularly important distinction: don't conflate “global languages” with “global compliance.” A course translated into 70 languages isn't necessarily appropriate for 70 jurisdictions. I'd require each vendor to show exactly how it handles jurisdictional differences.

If you tell me (1) employee count, (2) countries/regions, (3) your LMS, and (4) whether you need content-only or content + compliance platform, I can narrow this to a 2–3 vendor shortlist and give you an RFP scorecard.
